description:
I was playing alone at home. Then a man appeared and said I was a princess.

Even though you say you don't like it, they're dragging you along, right?

When I came to my senses, it was already a different world. I asked him what he was doing and he comforted me by saving the world. Ah, what on earth do I want from an adolescent high school girl who has not yet been able to save my life, let alone the world?

One girl tells you how to save the world.  
A story where anyone can save the world, an ordinary but not easy story.
